svg.title: From event bounds to atom bounds, tested on random laws
svg.desc: Each atom inherits the bounds of the nodes in its Möbius row; the resulting support-change bounds hold on random laws with empty cells.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: FROM EVENT BOUNDS TO ATOM BOUNDS, TESTED ON RANDOM LAWS
(a) Each atom inherits the bounds of the nodes in its Möbius row
Wα = Σβ |Mαβ| gJ(η), with J the groups of node β: an event that is an OR of J groups moves by
at most gJ(η) ≤ Jη, and Möbius inversion adds these moves with the absolute row weights.
Net atom bound: EΣ + 2Wα + |sα| g1, with sα = 1 only for the bottom node (Red).
(b) Realised change of Syn against its bound, 2,000 random pairs of laws (K = 8)

Laws: random on the 2 × 2 × 2 alphabet with some empty cells; q = (1 − t)p + tu. Seed 20260930. Theorem: pid-rs support-change report, Theorem 6.1.
